soldier: Head brownish yellow, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.57–0.62, the sides slightly broadened in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, concave between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent. The mandibles are stout, their apices strongly curved, the mandibular condyle prominently projecting, the length 0.52–0.53 of the head capsule length and 0.88–0.90 of the head width. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the two sides of the waist region parallel, the waist constriction index 0.32–0.415. The pronotum is about 1.51–1.67 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight, the four corners broadly rounded, the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin with a distinct notch, long hairs in the middle region reaching more than fifty.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
